meta.name: explore-code
meta.description: Rigor Improve implementation leaf skill for auditable candidate implementation in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory work on an isolated branch or worktree to transplant modules, adapt a backbone, add LoRA or adapter layers, replace a head, or stitch together meaningful low-risk migration ideas with rollback-aware records in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline reproduction, conservative debugging, environment setup, verified contribution claims, or default repository analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让研究代码里的模型改动变成可回溯、可回滚的探索实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你是深度学习研究者,总想在代码里尝试改模型,又怕改坏回不去。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do experimental edits to DL research code and need every change recoverable.

howto.what: 它会在隔离的分支或 worktree 上做探索性代码改动,比如移植模块、插入 LoRA、替换 head,并把改动理由、回滚方式和「仍是候选」的状态写入 explore_outputs/ 下的记录文件。
howto.when: 当研究者明确授权在隔离分支或 worktree 上做探索性改动,且任务是模块移植、backbone 适配、插入 LoRA 等低风险操作时接手;未经授权不接管。

say.text: 在隔离分支上把那个仓库的注意力模块移植过来
say.note: 产出候选改动与回滚记录

say.text: 给这个 backbone 插入 LoRA 层,记为候选改动
把这个 head 换成新的,保留回滚方式
say.note: 只做探索性改动,不动可信基线

howto.what_en: It makes exploratory code changes on an isolated branch or worktree — transplanting modules, adding LoRA or adapter layers, replacing a head — and records the rationale, rollback steps, and candidate status in explore_outputs/ files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory changes on an isolated branch or worktree, and the task is source-anchored module transplant, backbone adaptation, or LoRA insertion.

say_en.text: Transplant that attention module from the other repo onto an isolated branch
say_en.note: Produces candidate changes plus rollback records

say_en.text: Insert LoRA layers into this backbone and log it as a candidate
